shots.action: Both shop owners stand still, one glances at the other; a little dust drifts in the light.
He leans on the car and laughs while gesturing; the customers nod and smile.
The man in the truck smiles modestly and adjusts his cap slightly.
The people around him talk with small hand gestures; he looks around overwhelmed and raises a hand.
The landlord holds out the contract; the shop owner's mouth opens in shock and he leans back.
He slowly places a bill into the bankbook and smooths it; the lamp light is steady.
Snow falls gently in the alley; inside, the man rubs his head slowly in despair.
The blank paper sign flutters slightly; the man walks a step from his old truck toward the shop.
He looks around the shop calmly and takes a slow breath; dust sparkles in the sunlight.
